text:
kim: Proposal — split private deploy upgrade surface into two lanes: fast-path (in-place minor upgrades, preserve external IPs) and swap-path (sidecar swap for zero-downtime but requires IP change). Need field tradeoffs and launch criteria.

sanjay: +1 on lanes. banks want fast-path. main risk is config drift during in-place upgrades. rollback story must be ironclad.

mike: also add installer size goal. current airgap bundle is ~1.2GB; field asks for <300MB. we should spike bundle slimming.

lisa: launch checklist ideas: docs for operators, upgrade smoke tests, netops e2e, node-drain behaviour on k8s, KMS/HSM validation, telemetry opt-in flags. keep defaults conservative.

acme-eng: FYI from customer: their NOC won't allow IP renumbering in maintenance windows. sidecar-swap is a hard no unless we provide a no-ip-change mode. :eyes: 

kim: noted — add a `--preserve-external-ips` flag to the fast-path. We should document limitations (may require short downtime during leader election).

sanjay: also need a test harness to validate KV/prefix cache continuity across restarts; that's where in-place upgrades break sometimes.

mike: quick installer snippet we discussed for field testing:
```
installer --mode=fast-path --preserve-ips=true --airgap-bundle=/tmp/bundle.tar.gz
```

deploy-bot: nightly build 2026-03-20T03:15Z: private-distro-v2 image pushed :rocket:

lisa: proposed launch criteria (draft):
- median cold-start <100ms on our baseline GPU profile
- successful upgrade runs in 3/3 customer netops environments (incl. strict firewall)
- rollback verified in test harness (restore in <15min)
- no P0 model quality regressions post-upgrade
- runbook + automated rollback script present
Should we add SLA-mode for "no-ip-change"?

kim: yes add SLA-mode. I'll author the PRD section and include these criteria. tagging @mike @sanjay for engineering estimates.

acme-eng: can we formalize the "no-ip-change" SLA mode as "maintenance-window-friendly"? If implemented it'll unblock two enterprise deals.

mike: engineering impact notes: need dual-listen + ip-forwarding shim to hold external IPs while swapping internal listeners. Rough estimate: 2w infra work + 1w testing. Risk: increased complexity for troubleshooting.

sanjay: if customers sign the MSA for SLA-mode we bump priority to enterprise-blocker. Otherwise it goes into next quarter.

kim: Action items (owner / due):
- kim: write PRD section for "upgrade-lanes" and SLA-mode (EOD Fri)
- mike: run installer slimming spike and size targets (start Mon)
- lisa: define integration test matrix and provision 3 netops envs (this week)
- sanjay: build rollback + KV-cache validation scripts (next Wed)
- acme-eng: collect formal acceptance criteria from the two customers (ASAP)
We'll review at Thu product sync.

mike: one more — we should include a tiny troubleshooting guide with `iptables` and ip-forwarding checks, customers hit that frequently.

kim: agreed. I'll add a troubleshooting appendix.

acme-eng: thanks — this looks actionable. we'll follow up with customer-specific constraints. :thumbsup:
